workflow.description: Declare the selected generated client and author the symbolic schema and bounded named operations.
Compile, lock, and install through the exact change-review ceremony only when compiler-owned identity changes.
Materialize the selected typed client from the exact lock.
Invoke only generated named operations through the first-party runtime.

offline_compatibility: Sealed and explicitly offline bundles retain vendored @riffdb/application, riffdb-application, riffdb.dev/application, and the source-contained Rust SDK.
